activity_guides.title: Cognitive Flow & Coding Acoustics Guide
activity_guides.insight: psychoacoustic research shows that instrumental tracks between 60–85 BPM with high acoustic warmth (felt piano, Rhodes, or rain foley) and absence of sharp vocal transients prevent verbal working-memory interference during coding and reading.

activity_guides.title: Night Drive & Retro Synthwave Guide
activity_guides.insight: Steady 110–136 BPM arpeggiated basslines and gated-reverb percussion provide rhythmic optic-flow synchronization ideal for sustained alertness during highway night drives and fast-paced gaming.

activity_guides.title: Peak Workout & Cardio Cadence Guide
activity_guides.insight: Tracks with energy above 0.80 and tempos between 125–170 BPM synchronize with running stride cadence and recruit motor-cortex arousal during heavy resistance training.

activity_guides.title: Late-Night Introspection & Catharsis Guide
activity_guides.insight: Low-valence, high-acousticness arrangements (solo grand piano, weeping slide guitar, and slow minor-key progressions below 75 BPM) support emotional catharsis and quiet midnight reflection.
